description: Reference for recording diagnoses and proposed treatment on individual teeth with React Advanced Odontogram.

selection.description: Selection-based functions apply to every tooth currently selected in the chart.

diagnoses.description: Most diagnoses are derived from clinical tooth findings. Do not write diagnoses directly into a tooth record; use the chart functions so the finding, drawing, and exported diagnosis stay in sync.
diagnoses.addFunctionSupportedKeys: All toothDiagnosisKeys except caries. Caries must be recorded on a surface with setCariesSurfaceForSelection.
important: Diagnosis keys are identifiers, not display labels; use getToothDiagnoses or the diagnosis catalog for labels and codes.
Periodontitis and gingivitis are periodontal diagnoses, not toothDiagnosisKeys.
Peri-implant diagnoses are recorded on an implant using setPeriImplantForSelection.

treatmentPlan.description: The treatment plan is a separate chart, not a separate set of tooth fields. Switch to Plan mode before calling the same selection-based setters; the first visit to Plan starts as a copy of Status.
important: The Plan chart uses the same tooth fields and option values as Status; see tooth-settings.json.
Selection-based setters update the active chart only.
Plan tooth-selection choices are limited to none, tooth-base, and implant, except an existing tooth value remains available.
